title: Parametric spiral staircase (Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Vanilla Node.js (zero 3D dependencies, hand-written OBJ) that procedurally generates: Generate a helical staircase: rectangular step-tread boxes distributed along a helix around a central vertical axis, each step rotated incrementally around the axis and raised incrementally in height. Number of steps, helix radius, rise-per-step, and total rotation must be CLI-configurable. Save to obj with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
